CheckTitle: CodeBuild project contains plaintext environment variables
Description: CodeBuild projects found storing credentials, API keys, or secrets as plaintext environment variables.
Risk: Plaintext environment variables are visible in the AWS console, build logs, and API responses, making them vulnerable to unauthorized exposure or accidental leakage.

Recommendation.Text: Store sensitive values in AWS Secrets Manager or AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store and reference them using environment variables, to minimize the possibility of exposure.
